'''Ferrus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and weapon modifications in [[Farnel Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Ferrus appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Mods Vendor for Republic players on Balmorra.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Ferrus was removed from the game along with the rest of the Mods Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
